_comment: Physics configuration for Pokemon Pinball+. Values are in real units (pixels, pixels/frame). Converted to fixed-point 8.8 internally.
_comment_gravity: Pixels/frame^2 added to Y velocity each frame. Original: 0.043 (11/256)
_comment_max_velocity_hi: Maximum velocity in whole pixels/frame. Velocity clamped to +/-7
_comment_position_clamp_positive: Max position delta per frame (positive direction, ~5 pixels)
_comment_position_clamp_negative: Max position delta per frame (negative direction, ~-5 pixels)
_comment_stage_transition_up_y: Ball Y pixel position threshold to scroll up to top half
_comment_stage_transition_down_y: Ball Y pixel position threshold to scroll down to bottom half
_comment_stage_transition_y_offset: Pixel Y offset applied during stage transition (136 pixels)
_comment_flipper_delta: Flipper angular speed per frame (out of 15.0 max)
_comment_flipper_radius_magnitudes: 32 force magnitude values indexed by flipper collision radius (0-255). Higher = more force.
_comment_flipper_collision_x_min: Minimum ball X position for flipper collision detection
_comment_flipper_collision_x_range: X range from min for flipper collision (ball X must be < min + range)
_comment_flipper_collision_y_min: Minimum ball Y position for flipper collision detection
_comment_flipper_collision_y_range: Y range from min for flipper collision (ball Y must be < min + range)
_comment_damping_shift: Right-shift for velocity damping on collision (2 = divide by 4)
_comment_amplification_shift: Right-shift for amplification increment (3 = divide by 8, added per amplification unit)
_comment_spin_transfer_shift: Right-shift for spin-to-velocity transfer (1 = half of ball_spin added to X velocity)
_comment_spin_recalc_shift: Left-shift for spin recalculation from X velocity (2 = X * 4, then >> 8 for new spin)
